fields.label: Provider
fields.description: Telephony provider that places and receives this account's calls.
Enable this Acefone account for send/receive. Starts OFF — tick once the account is fully configured.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: The originating line that click-to-call rings (account-level default; overridden per agent by CRM Telephony Agent.acefone_number when set).
fields.label: Agent Number

fields.description: The DID shown to the customer on outbound calls AND the match key for inbound CDRs (did_number).
fields.label: Caller ID / DID

fields.description: Acefone API base URL (no trailing slash). Blank = code default (https://api.acefone.in).
fields.label: Base URL

fields.description: Bearer token for the Acefone REST API (click-to-call etc.) for this tenant.
fields.label: API Token

fields.description: Optional separate key for the Acefone 'Support' click-to-call variant.
fields.label: Click-to-Call API Key
Webhook Token
fields.description: Per-account inbound webhook secret. Appears in this account's webhook URL (/webhooks/telephony/<provider>/<token>/<event>) and both authenticates the caller and identifies the receiving account. Use a unique random value per account; blank = inbound disabled.

fields.label: Recording Host Allowlist (SSRF)
fields.description: Optional SSRF allowlist for recording fetches — pick the host(s) this account's recording URLs live on, e.g. the Acefone CDN (from CRM Trusted Fetch Host). If set, recordings are fetched ONLY from these hosts or their sub-domains. Blank = any public host (fetches to private/internal IPs are always blocked).

Set during a rotation. Both tokens authenticate until this is cleared, so rotating a secret never rejects a live call. Providers retry very few times -- Acefone retries twice -- so a call rejected mid-rotation is lost for good.
fields.label: Previous Webhook Token

fields.description: Derived, never entered. A Password field cannot be indexed, so this digest is what makes authentication one read rather than a scan and decrypt of every account.
fields.label: Token Digest

fields.description: The token is always enforced. HMAC is added only when the provider signs its payloads; Acefone and WATI do not.
fields.label: Authentication

fields.description: The header carrying the provider's signature, e.g. X-Signature.
fields.label: Signature Header

fields.description: Stripped before comparison, e.g. 'sha256='. Left blank when the provider sends a bare signature.
fields.label: Signature Prefix

fields.description: Left off unless the provider publishes its egress addresses. When on, a call from any other address is rejected.
fields.label: Enforce IP Allowlist

fields.description: One address or CIDR range per line, as published by the provider. Text after a # is ignored.
fields.label: Allowed Addresses
